endorsements.name: Aleksandr Tlyapov
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-3355
endorsements.description: IBM Tivoli Monitoring 6.3.0.7 through 6.3.0.7 Service Pack 21 could allow a remote attacker to traverse directories on the system. An attacker could send a specially crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)
